description: Preferred high-level native crash workflow. Use mode=current for an already stopped session, dump for read-only postmortem analysis, codelldb to discover CodeLLDB, lldb-dap to discover upstream LLVM lldb-dap, gdb to discover GNU GDB built-in DAP interpreter, or live with an already initialized generic DAP adapter. Do not use codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb/live when executing or attaching to the target is not authorized: those modes can run application code and cause its normal side effects, while current/dump only inspect stopped evidence. workflow.stage selects initial diagnosis, verification against a prior baseline, or the bounded autonomous cycle. Returns runtime evidence, diagnosis, verification/autonomous metadata, and debugger status with deterministic fixed/blocked/budget-exhausted outcomes where applicable.

adapterPath.description: Optional explicit debugger executable/adapter path for codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb/dump modes; omit to auto-discover the selected adapter.

analysis.description: Hints used to distinguish project code from runtime, system, or third-party frames.

callerDepth.description: How many project-controlled caller frames beyond the selected frame to inspect for provenance and root cause.

projectModules.description: Optional executable or library names treated as project-controlled modules during frame selection.

projectRoots.description: Optional local source-root paths used to recognize project-controlled stack frames.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the launched program in codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb modes.

breakpoints.description: Optional source breakpoints configured before a live/codelldb reproduction completes setup.

items.description: Source file and line breakpoints configured before a live reproduction runs.

lines.description: One or more 1-based source line numbers to replace as breakpoints for this source file.

source.description: Absolute or adapter-resolvable source file path.

configuration.description: Required for mode=live: adapter-specific DAP launch/attach configuration.

cwd.description: Working directory for the selected debugger/target launch and a project-root hint for diagnosis.

dumpAdapter.description: For mode=dump, choose CodeLLDB, upstream LLVM lldb-dap coreFile loading, or GNU GDB coreFile attach semantics.

dumpPath.description: Required for mode=dump: local path to the native core/minidump file.

env.description: Environment variables supplied to the launched program in codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb modes.

mode.description: current inspects an existing stop; live uses an initialized generic DAP session; codelldb starts CodeLLDB; lldb-dap starts upstream LLVM lldb-dap; gdb starts GNU GDB with --interpreter=dap; dump opens a frozen core/minidump.

program.description: Required for codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb launch modes; optional for CodeLLDB/GDB dumps but required when dumpAdapter=lldb-dap. Local path to the native executable.

request.description: For mode=live, choose whether the initialized DAP adapter launches a target or attaches to an existing authorized target.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request DAP timeout in milliseconds for the selected debugger adapter.

sessionId.description: Optional DAP session ID. Omit to use the backward-compatible default session.

snapshot.description: Bounds and optional evidence categories for a runtime crash snapshot.

disassembleAfter.description: Number of instructions after the selected instruction to request.

disassembleBefore.description: Number of instructions before the selected instruction to request.

includeDisassembly.description: Include best-effort disassembly around the selected instruction pointer when supported.

includeExceptionInfo.description: Request structured exception information for the stopped thread when supported.

includeModules.description: Include a bounded list of loaded executable images and libraries.

maxVariablesPerScope.description: Maximum variables returned per inspected scope, bounding evidence size.

moduleCount.description: Maximum loaded modules to include when module collection is enabled.

stackLevels.description: Maximum number of stack frames to inspect when collecting crash evidence.

threadId.description: Stopped DAP thread to inspect; omit to use the session-selected stopped thread.

sourceMap.description: For mode=dump, map source paths stored in debug symbols to local source paths.

stopOnEntry.description: When true in codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb modes, request an initial debugger stop at program entry before normal execution.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the reproduction to stop, exit, or terminate.

workflow.description: Controls one-shot diagnosis, explicit verification, or the bounded autonomous crash workflow.

agentState.description: Opaque autonomous state returned by the previous autonomous call; pass it back unchanged to continue the bounded cycle.

baseline.description: Verification baseline returned by an earlier diagnosis; required when stage=verify.

maxIterations.description: Maximum autonomous fix/reproduce iterations allowed when starting stage=autonomous.

stage.description: diagnose creates initial evidence; verify compares against a prior verification baseline; autonomous advances the bounded agent state machine.
